[!dolt] skip
# Test bd q creates issues with scripting-friendly output
bd init --prefix test --quiet

bd q 'Quick capture task'
stdout '^test-[a-z0-9]{3,}(\\.[0-9]+)?$'

bd show $ID --json
jq '.[0].issue.title'
stdout '"Quick capture task"'
jq '.[0].issue.issue_type'
stdout '"task"'

bd q 'Escalated bug' --type bug --priority 1 --labels urgent,backend
stdout '^test-[a-z0-9]{3,}(\\.[0-9]+)?$'

bd show $ID --json
jq '.[0].issue.issue_type'
stdout '"bug"'
jq '.[0].issue.priority'
stdout '^1$'
jq '.[0].labels | length'
stdout '^2$'
